text:
Winthrop women's soccer opens 2026 season against Western Carolina
H. P. Bell
Winthrop University's women's soccer team will begin its 2026 season with an away game at Western Carolina on Thursday, Aug. 13 in Cullowhee, North Carolina.
The Eagles are set to face the Catamounts at the Catamount Athletic Complex, with kickoff scheduled for 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time. The match will be available for viewing on ESPN+ and live statistics will also be provided. This matchup marks the ninth all-time meeting between Winthrop and Western Carolina, with the Catamounts leading the series 7-0-1. In their most recent contest on Sep. 7, 2025, Western Carolina won by a score of 2-0.
Head coach Spencer Smith is entering his seventeenth season leading Winthrop's program. The Eagles are coming off a preseason exhibition win over USC Lancaster and finished last season with a record of four wins, six losses, and six draws. Senior Monssi Avila-Gutierrez led Winthrop in goals last year with five and was named First Team All-Big South.
Several players have been recognized ahead of this season: Lindsay Sheets (forward), Monssi Avila-Gutierrez (midfielder), Cordelia McIntosh (midfielder), and Mia Silber (defender) were all named to the Big South Preseason Returning Players Watchlist. The roster includes eight freshmen and one transfer student among thirteen returning players from last year’s squad.
Winthrop has been picked to finish sixth in the Big South Conference Preseason Poll for 2026 as they look to improve upon their overall program record of 157 wins, 198 losses, and 52 draws since inception twenty-four seasons ago.
The Eagles' home opener is scheduled for Sunday night against UT-Chattanooga at Eagle Field; that match will also air on ESPN+. Fans can follow updates about Winthrop women’s soccer through their official social media channels.
